title: Illustration / Objects in space
slide_intent: Control viewpoint because inconsistent perspective can make related drawings appear to belong to different visual systems.
strategic_value: A flat line of sight can keep Duolingo icons simple and recognizable.
demonstration: Three yellow vehicles compare permitted flat views with a crossed-out angled view.
practical_value: Convey depth without changing the established line of sight.

content_islands.name: Viewpoint comparison
content_islands.spec: Align the three cars across the pale left panel, retaining the rejection frame around the right example.

content_islands.name: Perspective rule
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and flat-perspective explanation at right.

reference_purposes.Application: The cars demonstrate flat viewpoints and a rejected angled treatment.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Depth is allowed only on the same line of sight.

ingredient.name: Flat perspective
ingredient.application: Use a flat perspective; convey depth on the same line of sight.
ingredient.scope: Historical illustration guidance; this is not a prohibition on all overlap or depth.
